description: Deb Frecklington becomes leader of the Liberal National Party and Leader of the Opposition
Steven Miles is elected leader of Queensland Labor; sworn in as Premier of Queensland.
Annastacia Palaszczuk announces her intention to resign as leader of Queensland Labor and Premier of Queensland.
The ALP wins the Stafford by-election
The LNP defeats the KAP in the Hinchinbrook by-election
